### introducing-psake-agent-skill

Enhance your AI-assisted development with the new psake Agent Skill—bringing intelligent build automation guidance to Claude, GitHub Copilot, and other AI coding assistants.

- [Introducing the psake Agent Skill](https://psake.dev/blog/introducing-psake-agent-skill.md): Enhance your AI-assisted development with the new psake Agent Skill—bringing intelligent build automation guidance to Claude, GitHub Copilot, and other AI coding assistants.

### new-releases-and-more

Discover the latest updates and releases in psake and PowerShellBuild that you won't want to miss!

- [New Releases & More!](https://psake.dev/blog/new-releases-and-more.md): Discover the latest updates and releases in psake and PowerShellBuild that you won't want to miss!

### powershellbuild-v0.8.0-signing-and-docs

PowerShellBuild v0.8.0 brings Authenticode code-signing support for PowerShell modules, and comprehensive docs are now available on the psake docs site.

- [PowerShellBuild v0.8.0: Authenticode Signing & New Documentation](https://psake.dev/blog/powershellbuild-v0.8.0-signing-and-docs.md): PowerShellBuild v0.8.0 brings Authenticode code-signing support for PowerShell modules, and comprehensive docs are now available on the psake docs site.

### psake-5-0-0-released

psake 5.0.0 is a major leap forward for PowerShell build automation—bringing declarative task syntax, compile-time validation, file-based caching, structured output, and CI-native integrations.

- [psake 5.0.0 Is Here: Declarative Tasks, Caching, and Structured Output](https://psake.dev/blog/psake-5-0-0-released.md): psake 5.0.0 is a major leap forward for PowerShell build automation—bringing declarative task syntax, compile-time validation, file-based caching, structured output, and CI-native integrations.

### psake-vscode-extension-v1

The psake VS Code extension v1.0 brings task discovery, CodeLens integration, a dedicated task explorer, and smart build script detection directly into your editor.

- [psake Meets VS Code: The Official Extension Hits v1.0](https://psake.dev/blog/psake-vscode-extension-v1.md): The psake VS Code extension v1.0 brings task discovery, CodeLens integration, a dedicated task explorer, and smart build script detection directly into your editor.

### resilient-build-ps1

Extend your psake build.ps1 with clear error handling, dynamic tab completion, CI-safe module imports, and more.

- [Building a Resilient build.ps1 for psake Projects](https://psake.dev/blog/resilient-build-ps1.md): Extend your psake build.ps1 with clear error handling, dynamic tab completion, CI-safe module imports, and more.

### powershellbuild

- [Configuration Reference](https://psake.dev/docs/powershellbuild/configuration.md): Complete reference for the $PSBPreference hashtable and task dependency variables in PowerShellBuild.
- [Getting Started with PowerShellBuild](https://psake.dev/docs/powershellbuild/getting-started.md): Step-by-step guide to adding PowerShellBuild to a PowerShell module project and running your first build.
- [Introduction to PowerShellBuild](https://psake.dev/docs/powershellbuild/introduction.md): Learn what PowerShellBuild is, how it relates to psake, and when to use it for building PowerShell modules.
- [Real-World Example](https://psake.dev/docs/powershellbuild/real-world-example.md): A complete PowerShellBuild project with custom tasks, CI/CD integration, and PSGallery publishing.
- [Task Reference](https://psake.dev/docs/powershellbuild/task-reference.md): Complete reference for all pre-built psake tasks in PowerShellBuild, including dependencies and behavior.

### reference

- [psake Cheat Sheet](https://psake.dev/docs/reference/cheat-sheet.md): Quick reference guide for common psake patterns, commands, and useful one-liners
- [Configuration Reference](https://psake.dev/docs/reference/configuration-reference.md): Complete reference for all psake configuration options, parameters, and build script settings
- [Exit Codes](https://psake.dev/docs/reference/exit-codes.md): Reference guide for psake exit codes and how to handle them in CI/CD pipelines
- [Glossary](https://psake.dev/docs/reference/glossary.md): Definitions of key terms and concepts used in psake build automation

### troubleshooting

- [Common Errors](https://psake.dev/docs/troubleshooting/common-errors.md): Solutions to the most frequently encountered psake errors including task not found, module loading issues, path resolution, and dependency problems
- [Debugging Guide](https://psake.dev/docs/troubleshooting/debugging-guide.md): Complete guide to debugging psake builds using PowerShell debugger, verbose output, logging strategies, and task execution analysis
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://psake.dev/docs/troubleshooting/faq.md): Common questions about psake installation, usage, performance, and integration with other tools

### tutorial-advanced

- [Access Functions in Another File](https://psake.dev/docs/tutorial-advanced/access-functions-in-another-file.md): Use the include function to access functions that are in another script file.
- [Build Script Resilience](https://psake.dev/docs/tutorial-advanced/build-script-resilience.md): How to allow tasks to continue on error
- [Custom Logging](https://psake.dev/docs/tutorial-advanced/custom-logging.md): How to override psake's output handlers for custom logging
- [Debugging](https://psake.dev/docs/tutorial-advanced/debug-script.md): You can debug your psake build script in a couple of ways:
- [Logging Errors](https://psake.dev/docs/tutorial-advanced/logging-errors.md): By default, psake does not log errors to a file. When an error occurs, detailed error information is emitted to the console. Most CI servers capture all console output, so this is usually sufficient.
- [Outputs and Artifacts](https://psake.dev/docs/tutorial-advanced/outputs-and-artifacts.md): Best practices for returning data and managing build artifacts in psake scripts
- [Formatting Task Name](https://psake.dev/docs/tutorial-advanced/print-psake-task-name.md): How to modify the task name in your psake output.
- [psake Configuration File](https://psake.dev/docs/tutorial-advanced/psake-config.md): How to customize psake defaults with psake-config.ps1
- [Retry Rules](https://psake.dev/docs/tutorial-advanced/retry-rules.md): How to use retry rules
- [Structure of a psake Build Script](https://psake.dev/docs/tutorial-advanced/structure-of-a-psake-build-script.md): Learn how a build script is structured.
- [Variable Scope and References](https://psake.dev/docs/tutorial-advanced/variable-referencing.md): Learn how to leverage variables across your different tasks.
